## Vergleich Anzahl Daten DxI9000 und DxI800


```{r, SQL queries, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
n.single.query <- "
                  SELECT
                      (SELECT DISTINCT md.Methode
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.TestName = main.TestName AND main.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                      LIMIT 1) AS inlab,
                      
                    TestName AS DxI9000,
                    
                    COUNT(*) AS n,
                      
                      
                  (SELECT DISTINCT DoseUnit
                       FROM DxIvalData AS sub
                       WHERE sub.TestName = main.TestName AND sub.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                       LIMIT 1) AS Einheit,
                  
                  (SELECT 
                      -- md.Bezeichnung as DxI800,
                      COUNT(*) -- AS n_800
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.Probennummer = md.Probennummer AND d.Probennummer IS NOT NULL AND d.TestName = main.TestName
                      ) AS n_800,
                      
                  (SELECT DISTINCT m.EINHEIT
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.TestName = main.TestName AND main.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                      LIMIT 1) AS Einheit_800
                  
                FROM 
                  DxIvalData AS main
                WHERE
                  DoseResult <> 'No result'
                GROUP BY
                  TestName;"
n.single.dat <- dbGetQuery(con, n.single.query)
  

n.double.query <- "
  SELECT 
    subquery.TestName AS DxI9000,
    -- subquery.Methode,
    -- subquery.TestOrderCode,
    COUNT(*) AS n_Doppel,
    subquery.TestCompleteDT AS letzteMessung
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      a.Werte AS DxI800,
      d.DoseResult_c AS DxI9000,
      a.Bezeichnung,
      a.Methode,
      m.EINHEIT AS Einheit_800,
      d.DoseUnit AS Einheit_9000,
      d.Probennummer,
      d.TestName,
      d.TestCompleteDT
    FROM MeasurementData a
    JOIN MethodData m ON a.Methode = m.Methode
    JOIN TranslationData t ON a.Methode = t.Methode
    JOIN DxIvalData d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
    WHERE a.Probennummer = d.Probennummer 
      AND d.DoseResult <> 'No result'
  ) AS subquery
  GROUP BY subquery.TestName, 
        -- subquery.TestOrderCode, 
           subquery.Methode;
"

n.double.dat <- dbGetQuery(con, n.double.query)
```

```{r SQLqueriesPaBaReg , echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Alle TestName-Werte abrufen
test_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.TestName AS DxI9000, 
    CAST(md.Werte AS REAL) AS x, 
    CAST(d.DoseResult_c AS REAL) AS y
  FROM MeasurementData md
  JOIN MethodData m USING (Methode)
  JOIN TranslationData t USING (Methode)
  JOIN DxIvalData d USING (TestOrderCode)
  WHERE d.Probennummer = md.Probennummer
    AND d.DoseResult <> 'No result';")

# Sicherstellen, dass die Werte numerisch sind
test_data <- test_data |> 
  mutate(x = as.numeric(x), y = as.numeric(y)) |> 
  na.omit()

# Funktion zur Berechnung der Passing-Bablok-Regression
compute_pb_regression <- function(df, test_name) {
  xy_data <- df |> filter(DxI9000 == test_name)
  
  if (nrow(xy_data) > 2) {  # Mindestens 3 Werte für die Regression notwendig
    pb_model <- mcreg(xy_data$x, xy_data$y, method.reg = "PaBa")
    range <- paste(min(round(xy_data$y,2)), "bis", max(round(xy_data$y, 2)))
    slope <- round(pb_model@para[2, 1], 2)
    intercept <- round(pb_model@para[1, 1], 2)
    slope_CI_lower <- round(pb_model@para[2, 3], 2)
    slope_CI_upper <- round(pb_model@para[2, 4], 2)
    intercept_CI_lower <- round(pb_model@para[1, 3], 2)
    intercept_CI_upper <- round(pb_model@para[1, 4], 2)
  } else {
    range <- NA
    slope <- NA
    intercept <- NA
    slope_CI_lower <- NA
    slope_CI_upper <- NA
    intercept_CI_lower <- NA
    intercept_CI_upper <- NA
  }
  
  return(data.frame(DxI9000 = test_name,
                    Datenbereich = range,
                    m = slope, 
                    m_CI_l = slope_CI_lower, 
                    m_CI_h = slope_CI_upper,
                   # m1 = slope, 
                    i = intercept,
                    i_CI_l = intercept_CI_lower,
                    i_CI_h = intercept_CI_upper))
}

# Iteration über alle DxI9000-Werte
pb_results <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(test_data$DxI9000), compute_pb_regression, df = test_data))
```


```{r SQLqueriesVKsBias , echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(CLSIEP15)

# Alle benötigten Daten auf einmal abrufen
query <- "
    SELECT d.TestName AS DxI9000, 
           d.TestCompleteDT, 
           d.SampleID, 
           q.Level,
           CAST(d.DoseResult_c AS FLOAT) AS DoseResult, 
           d.DoseUnit, 
           d.Einheit_800, 
           q.Zielwert, 
           q.LotNr, 
           q.maxDate, 
           q.minDate
    FROM DxIvalData d
    JOIN TranslationData t ON d.TestOrderCode = t.TestOrderCode
    JOIN QCData q ON q.Parameter = t.RemisolCode
    WHERE d.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL;
"

# Datenbankabfrage ausführen
all_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(TestCompleteDT, "%m-%d-%Y"),
         maxDate = as.Date(maxDate, "%Y-%m-%d"),
         minDate = as.Date(minDate, "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  filter(Date <= maxDate & Date >= minDate)

# Funktion zur Berechnung von Präzisionsmetriken
fun.calc.prc.metrics <- function(data) {
  long_data <- data.frame(
    rep = rep(1:5, each = 5),
    name = paste(data$SampleID[1:25], rep(1:5, each = 5), sep = "_"),
    value = data$DoseResult[1:25],
    Zielwert = data$Zielwert[1:25]
  )
  calculate_aov_infos(long_data)
}

fun.calc.prc.data <- function(prc_data, data) {
  calculate_bias_interval(
    'E',
    nrun = prc_data$N / prc_data$k,
    nrep = prc_data$k,
    SWL = prc_data$SWL,
    SR = prc_data$SR,
    nsamples = 2,
    expected_mean = data$Zielwert[25],
    user_mean = prc_data$mean
  )
}


# Funktion zum Filtern und Verarbeiten der Daten für einen bestimmten TestName
fun.process.qc.data <- function(test_name, data) {
  test_data <- filter(data, DxI9000 == test_name)
  
  # Daten für Level 1 (L) und Level 2 (H) filtern
  prc.L.data <- filter(test_data, Level == 1 & grepl("[a-zA-Z]+1", SampleID))
  prc.H.data <- filter(test_data, Level == 2 & grepl("[a-zA-Z]+2", SampleID))
  
  # Mindestanzahl an Messungen prüfen
  if (min(nrow(prc.L.data), nrow(prc.H.data)) < 25) {
    warning(sprintf("Not enough data for %s. Skipping.", test_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Berechnung von Präzisionsmetriken
  prc.data.L <- fun.calc.prc.metrics(prc.L.data)
  prc.data.H <- fun.calc.prc.metrics(prc.H.data)
  
  # Berechnung von Bias-Werten
  bias.L <- fun.calc.prc.data(prc.data.L, prc.L.data)
  bias.H <- fun.calc.prc.data(prc.data.H, prc.H.data)
  
  # Erstellung des Wide-Format DataFrames
  data.frame(
    DxI9000 = test_name,
    `Intra_Assay_VK_L` = round(prc.data.L$CVR, 2),
    `Inter_Assay_VK_L` = round(prc.data.L$CVWL, 2),
    `bias.L` = round(bias.L$bias, 2),
    `Intra_Assay_VK_H` = round(prc.data.H$CVR, 2),
    `Inter_Assay_VK_H` = round(prc.data.H$CVWL, 2),
    `bias.H` = round(bias.H$bias, 2)
  )
}

# Verarbeitung der QC-Daten für alle TestNames
qc_results <- bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(unique(all_data$DxI9000), fun.process.qc.data, data = all_data)))


```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
date_color <- function(date) {
  days_until_expiry <- as.numeric(date - Sys.Date())
  color <- scales::col_numeric(palette = c("yellow", "green"), domain = c(0, max(days_until_expiry)))(days_until_expiry)
  return(color)
}
```
